01 / COST STRUCTURE

Know what the model carries.

Adjust each line, switch it off, or add a cost. Startup cash is shown separately from recurring break-even costs.

ⓘ

Researched values are published supplier or processor prices, not a guarantee for your exact product or checkout. Estimates are reasoned inputs; illustrative values are teaching placeholders. Your edits are labeled Student-entered. One-time startup purchases do not enter accounting break-even unless you turn on a depreciation period.
